AMENDMENT (gap analysis): Add these ACs to address dd-4 contrapositive + negative path.

- [ ] Default routing (no --source) does NOT invoke query-stats.sh — verified by test stub recording invocations to a sentinel file and asserting it stays empty
  Verify: bash tests/scripts/test-query-stats.sh 2>&1 | grep -qE 'default.*no.?call|no.?source.*preserves|default.?route.*not.*query-stats'
- [ ] Unknown --source value (e.g., --source=bogus) handled — either preserves default behavior OR exits non-zero with usage; behavior must be intentional and tested
  Verify: bash tests/scripts/test-query-stats.sh 2>&1 | grep -qE '(source=bogus|unknown.?source|invalid.?source)'
